Bituminous Layer (DBM/BC) Checklist 29 checkpoints across 6 sections.For all DBM/BC pavement layer construction; critical quality gate Download ExcelDownload PDF **29** Checkpoints **6** Sections Per paving batch/day; continuous throughout placement QC Engineer, Site Engineer [IS 73:1992](https://infralens.in/code/IS-73-2013) [IS 1203:1978](https://infralens.in/code/IS-1203-1978) [SP 20:2002](https://infralens.in/code/IS-20-2002) Related [📐IS 73](https://infralens.in/code/IS-73) [✏️Concrete cover](https://infralens.in/thumbrules/concrete-cover-by-exposure) [📘Waterproofing Materials & M…](https://infralens.in/handbook/waterproofing-materials) [📖Min cover for RCC](https://infralens.in/knowledge/minimum-cover-rcc-is-456) [🔧water-demand-lpcd-calculator](https://infralens.in/tools/water-demand-lpcd-calculator) ### Checklist Preview Expand all ↓ | S.No. | Checkpoint | IS Requirement | Status | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | A. BITUMEN & MIX DESIGN | | A1 | Bitumen grade and source approved; test certificates (penetration, softening point) available
Acceptance: Grade: 60/70 or 80/100 (per spec); penetration 60-70 or 80-100 dmm; test cert <6 months old | Cl. 503 — Bitumen approval | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A2 | Mix design report submitted and approved; JMF (Job Mix Formula) confirmed
Acceptance: JMF includes: binder %, aggregate grading, bulk density, void ratio, stability, flow; approved before production | Cl. 503 — Mix design submission | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A3 | Trial mix conducted; Marshall stability ≥1800 kg, flow 2-4mm, void ratio 3-5%
Acceptance: Marshall test results: stability ≥1800 kg, flow 2-4mm, VIM 3-5%; results documented and approved | Cl. 503 — Trial mix validation | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | A4 | All aggregate material complies with grading spec; size <0.1% variation from JMF
Acceptance: Sieve analysis 1 test per 100 tonnes; grading within ±0.1% of JMF; LA abrasion ≤40% | Cl. 503 — Aggregate control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B. PLANT & MIXING OPERATIONS | | B1 | Batch plant calibration current; weigh balances certified within last 6 months
Acceptance: Calibration certificate on site; ±2% accuracy for hot bins; ±1% for bitumen pump | Cl. 503 — Equipment control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B2 | Aggregate bins maintained at specified temperature; hot bin temp 130-160°C (verify thermometer)
Acceptance: Drum temperature: 160-170°C ±5°C; verified with IR gun or thermocouple at start and 2-hourly | Cl. 503 — Temperature control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B3 | Bitumen heater maintains 135-150°C; verified with temperature probe at pump outlet
Acceptance: Bitumen temp: 135-150°C ±3°C; checked hourly with certified thermometer; logged on chit | Cl. 503 — Bitumen temperature | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B4 | Mixing drum temperature maintained at 160-170°C; verified with laser/IR gun
Acceptance: Drum temp: 160-170°C ±5°C; IR gun verified every 30 minutes during production | Cl. 503 — Mixing temperature | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B5 | Discharged mix temperature 155-165°C; checked at discharge point with thermometer
Acceptance: Mix temp at discharge: 155-165°C ±3°C; recorded on each truck ticket; variation <5°C | Cl. 503 — Discharge temperature compliance | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | B6 | Batch weight tolerance ±2% of target (e.g., ±20kg for 1000kg batch)
Acceptance: Each batch: target weight ±2%; scale certified; documented on batch ticket | Cl. 503 — Batch weight accuracy | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C. TRANSPORT & PAVING OPERATIONS | | C1 | Truck bed cleaned, dried, and light tack oil applied before loading to prevent sticking
Acceptance: Tack oil <100ml per truck; clean bed; no residual mix from previous loads | Cl. 503 — Material handling | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C2 | Material transported to site within 2 hours of discharge; temp monitored <3°C drop
Acceptance: Transport time: <2 hours maximum; delivery temp ≥135°C; documented on ticket | Cl. 503 — Transport time control | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C3 | Base course inspected and approved for overlay; surface clean of debris and loose material
Acceptance: Base course sign-off available; tack coat applied if required; no standing water | Cl. 503 — Surface preparation gate | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C4 | Prime coat (RC-2 or MC) applied to base course if required; coverage >1.2 kg/m²
Acceptance: Prime coat: uniform coverage ≥1.2 kg/m²; dark coat on base; tested per ASTM D439 | Cl. 503 — Prime coat requirement | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C5 | Material laid by approved spreader or paver within 4 minutes of arrival at site
Acceptance: Paver operational <4 min from truck arrival; screed temperature 140-150°C maintained | Cl. 503 — Laying promptness | OK
NC
NA
HOLD | | C6 | Paver laid in uniform passes with consistent speed; transverse joints tight (<3mm gap)
Acceptance: Joint gaps <3mm; paving speed uniform; no stop-start within 100m sections; visual 100% | Cl. 503 — Laying control | OK
NC
